decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's water-infrastructure offer, was promoted to its own web page, and represents invested capability that management would not write off.

Although the public waste bin is distant from the core business, the firm committed publicly with its own page and reuses its powder-coating equipment, so weak results can still be blamed on a young market and keep it in place.
As a multi-model line it embodies substantial investment and visible commitment to diversifying the coating business, which makes management inclined to persist rather than admit a misstep.
The outdoor ashtray line shares coating and fabrication resources with the bin lines and was announced as a product family, so dropping it would undercut the visible diversification decision.
